notes.title: 2 technical issues
notes.content:
We were noticed about two problems with the game. 

1. First round does not work after first answer. New music question has old answers. Right now you just should skip to second round.

2. Memory leak. Songs are not released from memory and cause game to stop/crash.

We are preparing fixes, soon it will be resolved.

Sorry for the issues!
